dct_title_s: Soil Moisture (Single Channel Algorithm, Night), Aqua/AMSR-E
dct_description_sm: The Soil Moisture (Single Channel Algorithm, Night) layer displays gridded estimates of soil moisture in the top 1 cm of soil, averaged over the AMSR-E retrieval footprint, and is measured in grams per centimeter by volume (g/cm³) Soil moisture is estimated from AMSR-E/Aqua L2A brightness temperature (Tb) measurements using the Single Channel Algorithm (SCA) approach.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 2002-06-01 to 2011-10-04. Made from AMSR-E/Aqua L2B Surface Soil Moisture, Ancillary Parms, & QC EASE-Grids V003 (AE_Land, version 3, doi:10.5067/3JUPY6PAHHCP).
dct_publisher_sm: United States. National Aeronautics and Space Administration
